reviews.comment: had him for chem 227 and 228 and I absolutely adore dr. michaudel. he truly care so much about ochem and his students and wants them to succeed. go to his review session and the pltls, put in the time and you will do fine! he is also so funny!

Oh Quentin, where do I even start? Quentin knows his stuff, and he expects you to treat this class as a priority. GO TO CLASS! his lectures and help sessions through the week and exam reviews he will show you what you will see on the exams, and make you proficient, especially with synthesis and mechanisms. the Q lowers grade cutoffs (83 is an A).
Hard professor, would not take. Lectures were not useful to me.

I loved michaudel he was genuinely so funny and seemed to really care about his students. Although his lectures weren't the best, his help sessions were very helpful. The PLTL sessions were also so helpful so go to those as much as you can! He lowers the thresholds on letter grades based on the difficulty and grades very fair. He's a great option.
Michaudel might be the funniest professor I've ever had, a great guy and 227 wasn't really all that difficult, despite the scary reputation of ochem.

He is a great professor, cares a lot about his students and genuinely wants them to learn. Even if you don't understand organic well, so long as you put in the effort, he will grade you well. Lots of extra credit/easy points with iClicker, AKTIV, and partial credit on exams. Don't miss class, practice, and you will do great!
Professor makes the grading guidelines very clear. There is a very lenient curve/grading system and if the student does everything expected then they should get the grade they earn.

This professors expects everyone to prioritize this class as if we don't have other classes. every exam we took the average got lower than before. The only people that helped me get an A are the PLTL people. special thanks to Michelle, you are the goat.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him for 227 and 228 and really I think he can do better than this. Fair Grader and cares about Chemistry. His review sessions are not good and his feedback are even worse. Not the best but it was alright.

Took him last semester for CHEM 227 & taking him for CHEM 228 right now. Organic chemistry is challenging for me but even then I have managed to stay at a very comfortable B for both semesters. Michaudel just has a very wimsy French personality that American students can't handle but us genuinely a very good professor. If you try you'll succeed.

By far the best professor I've had. He gives tons of extra credit if you do Aktiv, he curves the grades, and he has PLTL sessions if you need extra help. He's actually funny and can keep your attention for the whole 75 min lecture. Anyone complaining about him either doesn't put in the effort to study or doesn't attend review/PLTL sessions.
He grades on a great curve and really wants everyone in class to succeed.

The class is for sure lecture heavy and he doesn't post the whole notes online so you really do have to go to every class. HUGE amounts of partial credit, and curves the final grade. Lots of extra credit too. As long as you put in the work you'll have a pretty solid A. Super chill professor and class.
no, just no :)
DO NOT TAKE HIM!

If I could give him a zero, I would. Not understanding what so over, doesn't really care about his students. Expects you to prioritize his class like it is the Holy Grail. If you have the opportunity to take anyone else, do it. Do not take him!!!

Do NOT take him. Not sure how his rating is so high. All the material provided by him is useless, he doesn't go into detail or explains the material. As he says "I do not grade based on how well you do but based on how much you deserve it." He is not understanding, expects you to prioritize his class over your life.

Attendance is not mandatory, but he does iClicker pretty much every class. His lectures are amazing and organized very well, so it is not hard to understand the material if you put in the effort. His review sessions are also helpful for exams and he is happy to help in office hours if you are struggling to understand a concept. Exams are fair
Difficult course, but he makes it bearable. His review sessions, studying problem sets, etc. are really helpful if you get lost.

Dr Michaudel taught the lecture portion of 231 this semester. Attendance is mandatory through IClicker but the class is only once a week. There is only one final exam that covers the lecture material and the problem sets somewhat prepare you for it. The lectures are alright but it can get a little confusing at times. Decent professor overall.

His lecture slides are very helpful. Tests are open note but still really hard. PRACTICE every week or you'll struggle to keep up. Attend his review sessions and SI (for his old exams) because they don't upload answers. His old exams are nothing like the new exams he makes. He lowered the grade cutoff to like an 81 for an A :D
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are open note, and he holds his own review sessions.

Definitely one of my favorite professors ever! He made ochem so much easier with his fun lectures and you can tell how much he cares about his students. Definitely go to his review sessions and start on OWL hw early. It was nice having open note exams and he also adjusted the grade distribution after each one.

TAKE HIM!!!!! He is the best professor I have ever had. So caring and an amazing teacher. I am no chemist nor did I do well in gen chem but if you go to review sessions show up to class do the OWL and a little studying you will earn a solid B. Open note exams give a lot of partial credit. Go to office hours, he really wants to help you!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Michaudel is the BEST!!! Gives lots of partial credit/bonus points, open note tests similar to practice, makes OChem fun. How to succeed: 1)do the OWL HW 2)attend class and work with the people around you on the participation iClicker 3)participate actively in weekly review sessions 4)ask questions-he is very patient and explains well!

Dr. Michaudel has been my favorite professor so far during my time at A&M. He made ochem, an inevitably challenging course, so enjoyable and fun. I always looked forward to going to his lectures. Dr. Michaudel is so caring and even printed me an article after I talked with him about an ochem topic I was interested in. Study hard, youll do well.

The homework is super long. I attended many of his SI sessions on zoom, and they all last about 2 hours. It was a big waste of my time! Everybody was confused and had kept on asking many questions which had prolonged the session. He expects yall to do the work on Jamboard having to be already prepared.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Michaudel is amazing and very caring Make sure to read the textbook before class and ask questions the moment you are confused, since OCHEM does build ontop of each other. OWL is a pain. The exams (open note) aren't too bad if you study, and luckily he adjusts the letter grade cutoff based on how well everyone is doing.

Professor Michaudel makes ochem so much more understandable. He provides lecture shell notes for you to fill out in class, hosts review sessions weekly that really prepare you for the tests, and he is very accessible outside of class. His tests are very comparable to the practice tests and are very fair. He is the best choice for ochem.

TAKE THIS DUDE!!! He's such a great professor and he's HILARIOUS. He teaches super well, the material is just pretty difficult in itself. I wish I could take him for Ochem 2 because he's the only man I'd trust to learn that stuff. Participate in class, he does Iclicker and its much easier to understand if you attend class. 10/10

Best teacher I've had at A&M so far! So caring and actually makes the subject matter interesting. Tests were open note and were a very reasonable difficulty and length. I would read the textbook before class, pay attention in class, do the homework, attend his review sessions, and study for each exam a few days in advance and ended with a high A.

Every Professor should want to be like Professor Michaudel. He is the most understanding, caring, helpful professor I have met. You can tell that he wants his students to understand and succeed in the class, yet at the same time, understands that Organic Chemistry may be the hardest course available so he trys his best to help you. Inspirational
This prof is one of my fav profs I've had at A&M, he is very kind, amazing at explaining things, very patient and he has very reasonable, open note tests. His review sessions are very helpful as well

He is an amazing professor, and he truly cares about his students very much! During class, he will always stop and make sure to answer every question as thoroughly as possible, and he is super patient; he's never mad, and he is always happy to clarify anything. Tests are very manageable if you study, and he wants his students to do well. Take him!

One of the best organic lectures that I have ever had. He goes really fast in lecture covering a lot of material and give out hard group homework. His tests, however hard and depressing they were, somehow resulted in acceptable grades. I haven't been this excited for a class for a long time since freshman year, or it might just be the caffeine.
